name: zju-learning-tools
description: Safely query ZJU learning services and download official course resources through a local read-only MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Query ZJU courses and download official resources.
interface.longDescription: Use six focused workflows for authentication, course planning, assignments and grades, assessment notices and discussions, official resource downloads, and Zhiyun classroom data through a local read-only MCP. Credentials never enter the agent context, and campus-side write actions are not exposed.
defaultPrompt: Review my current ZJU courses and upcoming todos.
Find resources for this ZJU course and let me choose what to download.
Summarize my assignment status without submitting anything.
Check whether my private ZJU session is ready.
